content.title: WEG 261-3270 Single Phase Electric Motor, Frame 80B, B5 Flange Mount, Class B Insulation
content.short_description: WEG 261-3270 single phase electric motor in frame size 80B with B5 flange mounting and Class B insulation.
content.long_description:
The WEG 261-3270 is a single phase electric motor built on an 80B frame with a B5 flange mounting configuration. This mounting type uses a flange with through-holes for face mounting to a mating machine component, suited to applications where a foot-mounted base is not practical.

The motor is rated with Class B insulation, indicating a maximum allowable winding temperature rise consistent with this insulation grade for continuous duty operation.

Frame size 80B places this motor in the smaller output range typical of light to medium industrial and commercial equipment applications where single phase power supply is available. Confirm shaft dimensions, mounting hole pattern, and terminal box orientation against the 80B/B5 standard before specifying for a replacement or new installation.
